name: High-current design
description: Nets carrying more than about 3 A continuous or 10 A peak.
placement_rules: Power devices grouped with their capacitors; connectors at the edge nearest the power stage
routing_rules: Polygons instead of traces above 3 A; widths from desk.ipc for the declared current and rise
Parallel vias for layer changes per desk.ipc.vias_required
copper_rules: Thermal relief off on power pads; heavy copper option recorded
verification_requirements: Peak and continuous currents declared per net (fail-closed)
